method: Independent manual review of all 50 prompts, options, explanations and hints, cited original slide text and definitions; exhaustive independent Boolean evaluation where applicable; finite set/graph arithmetic. Original PPT/PPTM files read as ZIP data only; macros never executed. Questions are new applications of module concepts, not verbatim source exercises.
